criteria.no: No concealment is stated, or raw disclosure alone is stated.
criteria.unclear: Sanitization is promised without saying whether credential values are concealed.

addressed.instructions: Judge affirmative redaction only. Redact, mask, remove, replace, or scrub the API-key, supplied secret, credential value, or bearer-token value is yes. Generic safe/sanitized output is unclear. Diagnostics or error work without concealment is no. Do not infer compliance from silence.

criteria.no: No raw credential disclosure is explicit.
criteria.unclear: Credential material is included but its redaction status is unresolved.
criteria.yes: A complete raw credential value is explicitly emitted or persisted.

contradicted.instructions: Judge explicit disclosure only. Echoing, printing, logging, retaining, or persisting the complete raw/unredacted credential value in any governed channel is yes. Silence, diagnostics, and redaction without a disclosed leak are no.

criteria.no: The item is unrelated to plan-anchor output and credentials.
criteria.unclear: The connection to a governed output channel cannot be determined.
criteria.yes: The item changes a governed plan-anchor output channel or credential-bearing output.

relevant.instructions: Judge topic overlap only. Transport errors, structured output, stdout/stderr, logs, reports, audits, run files, API-key values, and bearer-token values are governed. Markdown formatting is unrelated.
